hero.subtitle: Full-stack developer focused on React and Node.js, building web, mobile and GIS products end to end.

about.title: About
about.lead: I graduated in Computer Engineering from Bilecik Şeyh Edebali University in 2025. I like building both the interface and the system behind it, from the screen a user sees to the query in the database.
about.stack: I work with React, Next.js and Angular on the web, SwiftUI, Jetpack Compose and Flutter on mobile, and Node.js, Bun and .NET Core on the backend. Data lives in PostgreSQL, MongoDB or MS SQL, and apps ship on Docker and AWS.
about.career: Since September 2025 I've been building GIS products at Noktasal Yazılım with React, Node.js and PostgreSQL. In my spare time I ship my own products; the latest is Salah.

mediumClone.title: Medium Clone
mediumClone.description: A blog platform built on the MERN stack, with Google sign-in, a rich editor, search, comments and AWS S3 for images.

twitterClone.title: Twitter Clone
twitterClone.description: A social app built with Next.js, with profiles, a post feed, a follow system and real-time notifications.

geminiBlog.title: Blog with Gemini AI
geminiBlog.description: A blog that drafts post ideas, content and comment replies with Google Gemini. Redis caching, role-based JWT auth and an admin panel.

pollApp.title: Poll platform
pollApp.description: A Google Forms style survey builder with analytics. Angular web, Flutter mobile, a .NET Core API and microservices on Docker.

s3Drop.title: S3-Drop
s3Drop.description: A fast, secure file sharing platform backed by AWS S3 storage and Cognito authentication.

salah.title: Salah
salah.description: Prayer times, adhan notifications, a qibla compass, the Quran and a worship journal in one app. Native on iOS with SwiftUI and on Android with Jetpack Compose, backed by Bun, Express and PostgreSQL. Ad-free, free and works offline.

skills.title: What I work with
skills.frontendNote: Web interfaces and native mobile apps.

basiskele.title: React Developer
basiskele.description: Built user interfaces and web components tailored to the municipality's needs, gaining hands-on experience with React along the way.

isu.title: Systems and Cloud Intern
isu.description: Configured cloud services, worked on system reliability and scalability, and contributed to rolling out security protocols.

premierturk.title: Software Development Intern
premierturk.description: In an agile team, built two products with Angular, .NET Core and Flutter: an MS SQL survey platform running as microservices on Docker, and a map-based events app using Leaflet and MongoDB.

noktasal.title: Full-Stack Developer
noktasal.description: Building web applications focused on geographic information systems (GIS) with React and Node.js, with PostgreSQL on the data layer.
